findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so stored customer data is not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest with a bucket-managed policy.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving financial objects without Terraform-enforced encryption at rest.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects are not protected by an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest policy.
The data-science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving stored data without Terraform-enforced encryption at rest.
